0.1.0.description:
```Changelog:
New features:
    Hard logic: allows for unintended methods of stopping certain animatronics
    Scaresanity: Creates 56 new checks in total for each animatronic (excluding fredbear)to either jumpscare you or annoy you.
    Deathlink!
    Note: Deathlink and scaresanity are not compatible and will throw an error when used together
    
Generation changes:
    You can now set the target score to the minimum amount without excluding animatronics manually
    You can now exclude animatronics with challengesanity enabled.

Logic changes (doesn't apply to hard logic):
    Golden Freddy now requires the Mask
    Rockstar Freddy now requires the Heater
    The Power Generator and Deathcoin are now progression items
    To get scores above 8k points, you need to have the Power Gen, Deathcoin and Global Music Box unlocked
    
Bug fixes:
    Fixed challenges not activating the proper animatronics when they are not unlocked. Challenges now no longer give any points.
    Fixed Client not connecting to room, if there's an empty CNAP file
    Fixed client not reading checks in some cases. If you notice you’re not sending checks when you should, try waiting 30 seconds at most to see if the issue fixes itself. If waiting didn’t help, use the resync command.```

Quickfixes:
04.08: Made Music Man Scaresanity require Power Generator to be in logic

0.1.1.description:
New features:
	Game now displays the apworld version number
	Death Link now has an amnesty option (3 at default)

Client changes:
	Client now displays the current version number when opened

Fixed Bugs:
	Deathlink not turning on when joining a room
	Vanilla Dee Dee not turning on when joining a room
	Fixed issue where the client freezes and cannot be reopened if the save file breaks
	Fixed some Deathlink message typos
	Fixed issue where a world couldn't be generated if the target score required all avaiable animatronics to goal, and Bonnie was
	excluded but Foxy wasn't in normal logic 
	Fixed issue where the target score didn't lower if it's higher than the max possible score 
	Fixed issue where Bonnet's scaresanity would send out nightmare fredbear's check instead

Logic Changes:
	Music Man's scaresanity now requires the Power generator
	Bonnet's, The minireena's and Lolbit's Scaresanity now requires the Power AC
